        self.tail = None

    def create_linked_list(self):
        # 添加第一个结点
        node1 = Node(80)
        # both head and tail is the first node
        self.head = node1
        self.tail = node1

        # 添加第二个结点
        node2 = Node(9)
        # 更新指针
        node1.next = node2
        node2.prev = node1
        # node2成为新的尾结点
        self.tail = node2

        # 添加第三个结点
        node3 = Node(14)
        # 更新指针

        node3.prev = node2
        # node3成为新的尾结点
        self.tail = node3

        # start at head
        current = self.head
        print("None", end = " <-> ")
        # 循环，直到结点为None
        while current is not None:
            print(f"{current.data} <-> ", end="") 
            current = current.next
        print("None")
    # 反向遍历链表
    def reverse_traverse(self):
        # 从尾结点开始
        current = self.tail
        print("None", end = " <-> ")
        # 循环，直到结点为None
        while current is not None:
            print(f"{current.data} <-> ", end="") 
            current = current.prev
        print("None")

        # 初始化新结点
        new_node = Node(data)
        # 更新链接
        new_node.prev = self.tail
        self.tail.next = new_node

def insert_at_position(self, position, data):
    # 检查位置是否有效
    if position < 0 or position > self.node_count():
        print("Invalid position")
        return
    # 如果位置为1，则在开头时执行插入
    elif position == 0:
        self.insert_at_beginning(data)
        return
    # 如果位置等于结点数，则在末尾插入

        self.append(data)
        return
    else:

        new_node = Node(data)
        # 将指针指向所需位置
        current = self.head
        for i in range(position - 1):
            current = current.next
        # 获取指向下一个结点的指针
        next_node = current.next

        # 更新指针
        current.next = new_node
        next_node.prev = new_node

        new_node.prev = current
        new_node.next = next_node

class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.prev = None
        self.data = data
        self.next = None
 
class DoublyLinkedList:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = None
        self.tail = None
 
    #  遍历链表
    def traverse(self):
        current = self.head
        print("None", end = " <-> ")
        while current is not None:
            print(f"{current.data} <-> ", end="") 
            current = current.next
        print("None")
 
    # 反向遍历链表
    def reverse_traverse(self):
        current = self.tail
        print("None", end = " <-> ")
        while current is not None:
            print(f"{current.data} <-> ", end="") 
            current = current.prev
        print("None")
    # 结点计数
    def node_count(self):
        current = self.head
        count = 0
        while current is not None:
            count += 1
            current = current.next
        return count
 
    # 检查是否为空
    def is_empty(self):
        return self.head == None
 
    # 追加到空链表
    def append_to_empty(self, data):
        new_node = Node(data)
        self.head = new_node
        self.tail = new_node
 
    # 在末尾插入（追加）
    def append(self, data):
        if self.is_empty():
            self.append_to_empty(data)
            return
        new_node = Node(data)
        new_node.prev = self.tail
        self.tail.next = new_node
        self.tail = new_node
    
    # 在开头插入
    def insert_at_beginning(self, data):
        if self.is_empty():
            self.append_to_empty()
            return
        new_node = Node(data)
        new_node.next = self.head
        self.head.prev = new_node
        self.head = new_node
    
    # 插入位置
    def insert_at_position(self, position, data):
        if position < 0 or position > self.node_count():
            print("Invalid position")
            return
        elif position == 0:
            self.insert_at_beginning(data)
            return
        elif position == self.node_count():
            self.append(data)
            return
        else:
            new_node = Node(data)
            current = self.head
            for i in range(position - 1):
                current = current.next
            next_node = current.next
            current.next = new_node
            next_node.prev = new_node
            new_node.prev = current
            new_node.next = next_node
 
    # 从头开始删除
    def delete_from_beginning(self):
        if self.is_empty():
            print('Cannot delete from Empty')
        elif self.node_count() == 1:
            temp = self.head
            self.head = None
            self.tail = None
            del temp
        else: 
            current = self.head
            self.head = self.head.next
            self.head.prev = None
            del current
    
    # 从末尾删除
    def delete_from_end(self):
        if self.is_empty():
            print('Cannot delete from Empty')
        elif self.node_count() == 1:
            temp = self.head
            self.head = None
            self.tail = None
            del temp
        else: 
            current = self.tail
            self.tail = self.tail.prev
            self.tail.next = None
            del current
 
    # 从给定位置删除
    def delete_from_position(self, position):
        if self.is_empty():
            print('Cannot delete from Empty')  
        elif position <= 0 or position > self.node_count():
            print('Invalid position')
        elif position == 1:
            self.delete_from_beginning()
        elif position == self.node_count():
            self.delete_from_end()
        else:
            current = self.head
            prev_node = next_node = None
            for i in range(position-1):
                current = current.next
            prev_node = current.prev
            next_node = current.next
            prev_node.next = next_node
            next_node.prev = prev_node
            del current
 
linked_list = DoublyLinkedList()
linked_list.append_to_empty(2)
linked_list.append(4)
linked_list.insert_at_beginning(1)
linked_list.insert_at_position(2, 3)
linked_list.traverse()
 
linked_list.delete_from_position(2)
linked_list.delete_from_beginning()
linked_list.delete_from_end()
linked_list.traverse()
